title: Protocol #06: Solar Still Ground Moisture Distillation (Emergency Water)
summary: When surface water is depleted in barren terrain, utilize solar radiation and geothermal heat to vaporize groundwater and foliage moisture into pure, 100% pathogen-free distilled drinking water using a Solar Still.

materials.name: Concave Clay Pot or Shell (COLLECTION POT)
materials.desc: Deep, clean receptacle at least 15cm wide to catch dripping condensed droplets.

materials.name: Condensation Sheet or Broad Colocasia Leaves (CONDENSATION SHEET)
materials.desc: Airtight membrane covering the pit perimeter to funnel water vapor inward.

materials.name: Smooth Weight Pebble (WEIGHT STONE)
materials.desc: Small rock placed at sheet center to create an inverted cone dripping angle.

steps.title: 1-Meter Conical Pit Excavation & Foliage Lining
steps.description: Select damp, sunlit earth and dig a 1m diameter, 50cm deep conical pit. Hollow out a level depression at the bottom center to seat the collection pot.
steps.actionNote: > Action: Packing the pit walls with non-toxic green leaves or branches doubles moisture yield via plant transpiration.

steps.title: Central Pot Seating & Perimeter Soil Seal
steps.description: Anchor the collection pot squarely in the center. Drape the condensation sheet loosely over the pit and weight the entire perimeter with damp soil and sand.
steps.actionNote: > Science: A hermetic seal prevents vapor escape, elevating internal pit temperatures past 55°C to achieve saturated vapor pressure.

steps.title: Center Weight Placement & Condensate Drip
steps.description: Place a smooth pebble directly above the collection pot to form a downward cone. Water droplets condensing on the underside slide down the slope and drip into the pot.
steps.actionNote: > Caution: Maintain at least a 5cm gap between the sheet apex and pot rim so captured water does not wick into the soil.

fatalMistake.title: Fatal Mistake: Adding poisonous foliage to the pit or allowing sheet contact with soil.
fatalMistake.description: Attempting to increase moisture output by adding toxic weeds volatilizes lethal plant toxins directly into the distilled water. Additionally, loose dirt tumbling into the pot will contaminate the sterile water.
fatalMistake.consequence: Outcome: Ingestion of volatilized neurotoxins, acute renal failure, and rapid dehydration.
